card.what: This line specifies the API group 'appsv1' and the Kubernetes API version 'v1' for deletion operations.
card.why: Initially, this line was part of a workaround – a 'hack' – used in the deployment reaper to delete resources. However, subsequent development shifted away from this approach, relying entirely on server-side garbage collection for object removal. The original implementation was deemed flawed and unreliable, not working consistently across clients or API versions [1][2][3].
card.next: Before making any changes, verify that the deletion process is correctly relying on server-side garbage collection and that no other client-side logic is dependent on this specific API group and version [1][2].

answer: kubectl must keep the DaemonSet delete hack until servers have the server-side fix (1.11, backported to 1.10.x).
